address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县枫树岭镇淳杨线
intro: 下姜村位于杭州淳安县千岛湖畔，是远近闻名的美丽乡村，依山傍水、风景秀丽，以生态农业和乡村旅游闻名，可体验民宿、采摘与田园风光。
intro_en: Xiajiang Village is located by Qiandao Lake in Chun'an County, Hangzhou. It is a renowned beautiful village, nestled among mountains and waters with picturesque scenery. Known for its ecological agriculture and rural tourism, visitors can experience homestays, fruit picking, and idyllic countryside views.
address_en: Chunyang Line, Fengshuling Town, Chun'an County, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name_en: Qingzhen Xuexi Alley Chuanchuan (Skewer Hot Pot)
address: 北院门街道大学习巷68号、70号
intro: 清真学习巷串串位于西安回民街附近的学习巷，是一家以清真串串闻名的特色小吃店，深受当地人和游客喜爱，是体验西安街头美食的热门去处之一。
intro_en: Qingzhen Xuexi Alley Chuanchuan is located in Xuexi Alley near the Muslim Quarter of Xi'an. It is a specialty snack shop famous for its halal skewers, beloved by locals and tourists alike, and is one of the popular spots for experiencing Xi'an street food.
address_en: Nos. 68 & 70 Daxuexi Alley, Beiyuanmen Subdistrict, China

address: 重庆市渝中区上清寺街道重庆市人民政府
intro: 兰英大峡谷位于重庆市巫溪县，是知名的峡谷景观区，谷深壁陡、山势险峻，自然风光雄奇壮美，秋季红叶尤为出名，是游览观光和户外徒步的好去处。
intro_en: Lanying Grand Canyon is located in Wuxi County, Chongqing. It is a well-known canyon scenic area, featuring deep valleys, steep cliffs, and precipitous mountains. Its natural scenery is magnificent and majestic, and it is especially famous for its red autumn leaves, making it a great destination for sightseeing and outdoor hiking.
address_en: Shangqingsi Subdistrict, Yuzhong District, Chongqing — Chongqing Municipal People's Government

address: 四川省成都市青羊区草堂街道浣花南路251号
intro: 四川博物院位于中国四川省成都市城西青羊区，浣花溪公园旁，始建于1941年，是中国西南地区规模最大的综合性博物馆，藏品数量在中国大陆各类博物馆中位居第六，现有院藏文物35万余件，其中珍贵文物7万余件，国家一级文物1399件。
review_summary: 评分高达4.7，作为中国西南规模最大的综合性博物馆，院藏文物35万余件，紧邻浣花溪公园，值得细细游览。
intro_en: The Sichuan Museum is located in the west of Chengdu, Qingyang District, Sichuan Province, China, next to Huanhuaxi Park. Founded in 1941, it is the largest comprehensive museum in Southwest China. Its collection ranks sixth among museums of all kinds in mainland China, with over 350,000 cultural relics currently in its holdings, including more than 70,000 precious relics and 1,399 national first-class cultural relics.
address_en: No. 251, South Huanhua Road, Caotang Subdistrict, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
review_summary_en: With a rating as high as 4.7, it is the largest comprehensive museum in Southwest China, housing over 350,000 cultural relics. Located next to Huanhuaxi Park, it is worth a leisurely, in-depth visit.
opening_hours_en: today 09:00-17:00 open (last entry 16:00)

intro: 昭陵博物馆位于中华人民共和国陕西省咸阳市礼泉县烟霞镇政府西侧 、李勣墓 ，为国有文物、二级博物馆 。是为唐昭陵文物保护举办的一座博物馆。
intro_en: The Zhaoling Museum is located to the west of the Yanxia Town government in Liquan County, Xianyang City, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, at the tomb of Li Ji. It is a state-owned museum dedicated to cultural relics and a Grade II museum. It is a museum established for the protection of the cultural relics of Zhaoling, the tomb of Emperor Taizong of Tang.

address: 海南省海口市美兰区蓝天街道大英山西二街海南省人民政府
intro: 青海湖（ ，音错温布），又称库库诺尔（ ），在两语内意思均为“蓝湖”、“青湖”。古称西海、鲜水、鲜海、卑禾羌海等。位于中国青海省内青藏高原的东北部，是中国“最大的湖泊”，也是中国“最大的咸水湖、内流湖”，早期面积4236.6平方公里，有時因人為及氣候因素而極遽減小但也有擴大情況 ，环湖周长360多公里。湖水平均深约21米多，最大水深为32.8米，蓄水量1050亿立方米，湖面海拔3260米。青海湖湖水盐度为1.24% ，对比之下，一般海水含盐量为3.5%。
address_en: Hainan Provincial People's Government, Dayingshan West 2nd Street, Lantian Subdistrict, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan

address: 辽宁省沈阳市铁西区启工街道中国工业博物馆
intro: 沈阳工业博物馆位于沈阳市铁西区，是在老工业厂房基础上改建的博物馆，展示中国工业发展历程和老工业基地的历史记忆，馆藏众多老式机械设备与工业文物。
intro_en: Located in Tiexi District, Shenyang, the Shenyang Industrial Museum was converted from old industrial factory buildings. It showcases the development of China's industry and the historical memory of the old industrial base, with a large collection of vintage machinery and industrial artifacts.
address_en: China Industrial Museum, Qigong Subdistrict, Tiexi District, Shenyang, Liaoning

address: 陕西省西安市碑林区长安路街道友谊西路72号敕赐荐福寺
intro: 西安博物院位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市碑林区朱雀大街东侧，是一座集文物保护和陈列展示于一体的地方综合性博物馆。该馆为国家一级博物馆、国家AAAA级旅游景区，于2007年5月18日正式对外开放。全院占地面积16万平方米，博物馆建筑面积1.6万平方米，馆藏文物11万余件，其中国家三级以上文物1.4万余件。馆址依托唐代荐福寺而建，院内坐落有小雁塔，后者为全国重点文物保护单位，于2014年作为“丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道的路网”的遗产点之一被列入世界文化遺產名錄。
address_en: Chici Jianfu Temple, No. 72 Youyi West Road, Chang'an Road Subdistrict, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China

address: 重庆市南川区南城街道金佛山景区
intro: 金佛山是世界自然遗产，位于重庆南部南川区境内，属大娄山山脉，由金佛、箐坝、柏枝三山组成。金佛山主峰风吹岭海拔2251米，每年积雪期长达4个月之久，也是大娄山脉最高峰。在夏秋晚晴的时候，落日斜晖把层层山崖映染得金壁辉煌，如一尊尊金身大佛闪射出万道霞光，异常壮观而美丽，“金佛山”也因此而得名。
address_en: Jinfo Mountain, Nancheng Subdistrict, Nanchuan District, Chongqing

address: 重庆市北碚区金华路400号
intro: 重庆自然博物馆位于重庆市，是一座以自然科学为主题的博物馆，馆内展示古生物化石、动植物标本等展品，恐龙化石收藏尤为丰富，是了解自然历史和科普教育的好去处。
intro_en: Located in Chongqing, the Chongqing Natural History Museum is a museum themed on natural science. It displays paleontological fossils, animal and plant specimens, and other exhibits, with a particularly rich collection of dinosaur fossils. It is a great place to learn about natural history and science education.
address_en: No.400 Jinhua Road, Beibei District, Chongqing

name_zh: 鱼司机汽锅豆腐鱼(三溪口总店)
name_en: Yusiji Steam Pot Tofu Fish (Sanxikou Main Branch)
address: 同兴北路196号
intro: 鱼司机汽锅豆腐鱼（三溪口总店）是重庆北碚三溪口的一家豆腐鱼餐馆，以当地知名的豆腐鱼菜品为特色，采用汽锅烹制鱼肉与豆腐，是品尝三溪口豆腐鱼的去处之一。
intro_en: Fish Driver Steamed Pot Tofu Fish (Sanxikou Main Branch) is a tofu fish restaurant in Sanxikou, Beibei, Chongqing. Known for the locally famous tofu fish dish, it cooks fish and tofu in a steam pot, and is one of the places to sample Sanxikou tofu fish.
address_en: No. 196 Tongxing North Road, China

address: 重庆市江津区四面山镇赤壁路101号四面山镇人民政府
intro: 四面山风景名胜区位于重庆市江津区，以丹霞地貌、瀑布群和原始森林著称，望乡台瀑布颇为知名，是集避暑、观光、休闲于一体的国家级风景名胜区。
intro_en: Simianshan Scenic Area is located in Jiangjin District, Chongqing. It is renowned for its Danxia landforms, waterfall clusters, and primeval forests. The Wangxiangtai Waterfall is quite famous. It is a national-level scenic area integrating summer retreat, sightseeing, and leisure.
address_en: Simianshan Town, Jiangjin District, Chongqing

address: 北京市丰台区看丹街道早期的蒸汽机车北京汽车博物馆
intro: 北京汽车博物馆位于丰台区，是一座以汽车为主题的专题博物馆，馆藏中外各式汽车及相关展品，通过互动展览展示汽车发展历史与文化，是亲子游学和科普教育的好去处。
address_en: Early steam locomotives, Qiandan Subdistrict, Fengtai District, Beijing — Beijing Auto Museum

name_zh: 中国航空博物馆旅游区
address: 北京市海淀区四季青(地区)镇北四环西路95号
intro: 中国航空博物馆位于北京昌平区，是中国最大的航空主题博物馆，馆内收藏各型飞机及航空航天文物，展示中国航空发展历程，是航空爱好者和亲子游的好去处。
name_aliases: ["航空博物馆", "中国航博馆", "小汤山航空博物馆"]
address_en: No. 95 North Fourth Ring West Road, Sijiqing Town, Haidian District, Beijing, China

address: 虹桥路100号西藏大厦万怡酒店裙房2楼
intro: 圆苑位于上海徐家汇商圈，是一家本帮菜餐厅，以红烧肉等经典本帮菜肴闻名，是当地人和游客品尝地道上海风味的常见选择。
intro_en:
Location: Yuan Yuan (Xujiahui Branch)
Yuan Yuan is a Shanghainese restaurant located in the Xujiahui business district of Shanghai. Known for classic Shanghainese dishes such as braised pork, it is a popular choice for locals and tourists looking to sample authentic Shanghai flavors.
address_en: 2/F Podium, Courtyard by Marriott Xizang Hotel, No. 100 Hongqiao Road

address: 天津市蓟州区官庄镇古钟亭天津盘山风景名胜区
intro: 盘山风景名胜区位于天津市蓟州区，是京东著名的山岳风景区，以山势雄伟、松林苍翠、古刹遗迹众多而闻名，素有“京东第一山”之称，是登高揽胜和休闲避暑的好去处。
address_en: Tianjin Panshan Scenic Area, Ancient Bell Pavilion, Guanzhuang Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

intro: 雄村景区位于黄山市歙县，坐落于新安江畔，以山水风光和古村落文化著称，村内保存有竹山书院等古建筑，是徽文化旅游的知名目的地。

address: 四川省成都市大邑县西岭镇西岭镇西岭雪山风景名胜区
intro: 西岭雪山风景名胜区位于四川成都大邑县，因杜甫“窗含西岭千秋雪”诗句得名，以终年积雪的山峰、林海雪原和高山滑雪场闻名，是成都周边著名的避暑滑雪胜地。
address_en: Zhongshan Street, Xiling Town, Dayi County, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

intro: 上九山村景区位于济宁邹城，是一座保存较好的古村落，依山而建，石屋石墙颇具特色，游客可在此体验传统村落风貌与乡村民俗文化。

address: 河北省石家庄市井陉县苍岩山镇栾台垴苍岩山风景名胜区
intro: 苍岩山位于河北石家庄井陉县，山势险峻、古木葱郁，以桥楼殿等悬空古建筑闻名，福庆寺依崖而建，素有“五岳奇秀揽一山”的美誉，是太行山中著名的历史文化与自然景观胜地。
address_en: Cangyan Mountain Scenic Area, Luantaonao, Cangyanshan Town, Jingxing County, Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province

address: 陕西省西安市灞桥区红旗街道半坡遗址西安半坡博物馆
intro: 半坡遗址位于中华人民共和国陕西省西安市灞桥区半坡村，地处浐河下游右侧覆盖有黄土的二级阶地上，背依白鹿塬，与河床相距800米。半坡遗址是中国黄河流域新石器时代仰韶文化的村落遗址典型代表，至今已有六七千年的历史。
address_en: Banpo Site, Xi'an Banpo Museum, Hongqi Subdistrict, Baqiao District, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province, China

address: 陕西省咸阳市乾县城关街道乾陵博物馆
intro: 乾陵博物馆位于中华人民共和国陕西省咸阳市乾县城关街道 ，是依托乾陵陪葬墓——永泰公主墓建立的博物馆 。为国有文物 、一级博物馆 。
address_en: Chengguan Street, Qianxian County, Xianyang, Shaanxi Province (Qianling Museum)

intro: 渭南市博物馆位于陕西渭南，是展示当地历史文化的地方综合性博物馆，馆内收藏大量文物，通过展览呈现渭南地区从古至今的历史变迁与人文风貌。

address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘街道之江路148号杭州宋城
intro: 杭州宋城景区是位于杭州的大型宋文化主题公园，再现宋代市井风貌，园内有《宋城千古情》等大型演出，是杭州知名的旅游度假区。
address_en: No. 148 Zhijiang Road, Songcheng Hangzhou, Zhuantang Subdistrict, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang

address: 江西省新余市渝水区河下镇
intro: 仙女湖风景名胜区位于江西新余，湖水清澈、岛屿众多，山水风光秀丽，相传为“七仙女下凡”传说的发源地，是集观光、休闲、度假于一体的湖泊型风景名胜区。
address_en: Hexia Town, Yushui District, Xinyu, Jiangxi

intro: 青岛葡萄酒博物馆，位于中华人民共和国山东省青岛市市北区延安一路红酒坊，是一座以葡萄酒历史与文化展示为主题的主题特色博物馆，同时也是中国大陸首座以葡萄酒为主题的地下博物馆。

address: 辽宁省大连市沙河口区星海湾街道大连现代博物馆大连博物馆
intro: 下列是大连各博物馆的列表，此列表排名按关注度顺序。 大连市目前有大连自然博物馆、大连贝壳博物馆、大连现代博物馆等博物馆多个。现已全部免费开放。
address_en: Dalian Modern Museum (Dalian Museum), Xinghaiwan Subdistrict, Shahekou District, Dalian, Liaoning

intro: 四川自貢恐龍博物館位于中华人民共和国四川省自贡市大安区大山铺镇268号，是一座遗址类博物馆，也是中國第一所現代化的專業性恐龍博物館，包括了3个纲、11个目、15个科的属种 。位於四川省自貢市東北郊的大山鋪鎮238号。

address: 湖北省荆州市荆州区西城街道荆州博物馆
intro: 荆州博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖北省荆州市荆州区荊中路166号，是一座综合性地志博物馆，2008年被国家文物局评为“国家一级博物馆”。
address_en: Jingzhou Museum, Xicheng Subdistrict, Jingzhou District, Jingzhou, Hubei, China

name_zh: 青城山-都江堰风景名胜区
address: 四川省成都市都江堰市灌口街道都江堰景区鱼嘴分水堤
intro: 青城山-都江堰风景名胜区位于成都平原西部，包括幽静秀丽的道教名山青城山和战国时期李冰父子修建的著名水利工程都江堰，二者均为世界文化遗产。
address_en: Yuzui Water-Dividing Levee, Dujiangyan Scenic Area, Guankou Subdistrict, Dujiangyan City, Chengdu, Sichuan, China

name_zh: 南京市汤山紫清湖旅游区
intro: 南京市汤山紫清湖旅游区位于南京江宁区汤山，是一处以湖光山色和温泉资源为特色的生态旅游度假区，游客可在此观光休闲、泡温泉，亲近自然。

name_zh: 南京市水墨大埝旅游区
intro: 水墨大埝旅游区位于南京市浦口区，是一处集田园风光、自行车骑行道、亲子休闲于一体的乡村生态景区，环境清新，适合郊游度假。
苏州平江历史街区位于古城东北部，是苏州保存最完整的历史街区之一，河道与小街并行、古桥相连，保留着典型的江南水乡风貌，深受游客喜爱。

address: 湖北省武汉市武昌区东湖风景区街道湖北省博物馆(北门)
opening_hours: 周二至周五09:00-17:00 最晚进入16:00；周六至周日 09:00-20:30 最晚进入19:30；周一 全天不开放（法定节假日除外） ；法定节假日 08:30-18:00开放 最晚进入17:00
intro: 湖北省博物馆位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市武昌区东湖路160号，是湖北省唯一的省级综合性博物馆，也是国家一级博物馆、中央和地方共建的八家国家级重点博物馆之一，国家文物局挂牌的饱水漆木器保护基地，中国博物馆协会乐器专委会主任委员单位，主要承担着全省文物的收藏、保管、保护、陈列展览及藏品的研究工作。该馆是国家旅游局命名的国家5A级旅游景区东湖的重要组成部分。
intro_en: Hubei Provincial Museum, located at 160 Donghu Road, Wuchang District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China, is the only provincial-level comprehensive museum in Hubei Province. It is a National First-Class Museum, one of the eight national key museums jointly built by the central and local governments, a waterlogged lacquered wood artifact conservation base designated by the National Cultural Heritage Administration, and the chair unit of the Musical Instruments Committee of the Chinese Museums Association. The museum is mainly responsible for the collection, storage, preservation, exhibition, and research of cultural relics across the province. It is an important part of the East Lake National 5A Tourist Attraction named by the National Tourism Administration.

name_en: San Que Yi Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine (Shenxianshu Branch)

intro: 三缺一·成都味川菜（神仙树店）是成都神仙树片区的一家川菜餐馆，主打经典川味菜肴，家常氛围浓郁，是当地居民和游客品尝地道成都味道的去处之一。

intro_en: The Ming Tombs Museum is located at the foot of Tianshou Mountain in Changping District, Beijing. Established around the mausoleum complex of thirteen Ming Dynasty emperors, it showcases the history, culture, and unearthed artifacts of imperial Ming tombs, with the underground palace of Dingling open to the public.

The district brings together shops, teahouses, and everyday local life, making it a famous historic and cultural attraction in Haikou.

name_aliases: ["直隶总督署", "保定直隶总督署", "直隶总督部院", "总督署"]

intro_en: Juyongguan Great Wall, located in Changping District, Beijing, is one of the famous passes along the Great Wall. Since ancient times it has been a military stronghold guarding the north of the capital. The area within the pass boasts beautiful scenery, surrounded by mountains—"Juyong Guancui" (Green Ranges at Juyong) was once one of the famous Eight Scenic Views of Yanjing.

intro_en: Mingting Restaurant is located on Waicaojia Lane in Chengdu. A famous "hole-in-the-wall" eatery known for its home-style Sichuan dishes, it is popular with local diners and tourists alike, often requiring a wait in line, and is a top spot for experiencing authentic Chengdu street food.
address_en:
Location: Mingting Restaurant (Waicaojiaxiang Branch)
No. 26, Fu 15, Waicaojiaxiang, Jinniu District

intro_en: The Dazu Rock Carvings Digital Cinema is located in Dazu, Chongqing. Built on the basis of the Dazu Rock Carvings, a World Heritage Site, it vividly presents the art of the carvings through digital imaging technology, helping visitors gain an intuitive understanding of grotto culture. It serves as a complementary sightseeing experience venue for tours of the Dazu Rock Carvings.

intro_en: The Nanjing Jiangnan Silk Culture Museum, located in Nanjing, Jiangsu, is a museum themed on silk culture. Through its collections and exhibitions, it showcases the history, weaving techniques, and traditional craftsmanship of silk in the Jiangnan region, serving as a window into Chinese silk culture.

intro: 山，古称空同山，位于中国甘肃省平凉市以西11公里处，属六盘山支脉，南北走向，长约100公里，平均宽15公里，主峰翠屏峰海拔2123米，垂直高度683米 。相传广成子在此修炼得道，黄帝前来向他问道，崆峒山因而被称为“天下道教第一山” 。崆峒山集自然景观和人文景观于一身，有“西来第一山”、“西镇奇观”等美誉，是中国国家重点风景名胜区，也是中国五大武术流派之一崆峒派的发祥地 。
address_en: Kongtong Town, Kongtong District, Pingliang City, Gansu Province

南温泉位于重庆市巴南区，是重庆著名的温泉景区，以温泉水质优良著称，园内山清水秀，配有温泉浴场和园林景观，是市民休闲度假、泡汤疗养的胜地。
intro_en: Nanwenquan (South Hot Springs) is located in Banan District, Chongqing. It is a famous hot spring scenic area in Chongqing, renowned for its excellent hot spring water quality. With beautiful mountains and clear waters, the park features hot spring baths and garden landscapes, making it an ideal destination for locals seeking leisure, vacation, and therapeutic soaking.

intro: 秦始皇兵马俑博物馆位于陕西省西安市临潼区，是在秦始皇陵兵马俑坑原址上建立的遗址类博物馆，被誉为“世界第八大奇迹”，展示规模宏大的兵马俑军阵，是了解秦代历史与雕塑艺术的重要场所。
intro_en: The Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum is located in Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. It is a site museum built on the original location of the Terracotta Army pits of the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, and is known as the "Eighth Wonder of the World." Showcasing a vast array of terracotta warriors and horses, it is an important place for understanding Qin Dynasty history and sculpture art.

With convenient transportation, it offers accommodation for both business and leisure travelers.

With its homestyle rural cuisine and distinctive country specialties, it draws diners from the surrounding area to come and taste its food.

It specializes in silk-stocking milk tea, pineapple buns with butter, and a variety of Hong Kong-style dim sum. With its comfortable environment, it is a great place to take a break and dine while shopping and sightseeing.

Location: Chunyang Old Tavern · Sichuan Cuisine (Qixinggang Branch)

intro_en: Opened in September 1999, the Shanghai Public Security Museum has 10 exhibition halls: the Public Security History Hall, Martyrs Hall, Force Building Hall, Public Security Administration Hall, Criminal Investigation Hall, Traffic Management Hall, Prison and Detention House Hall, Fire Management Hall, Police Exchange Hall, and Police Equipment Hall, as well as a Fire Simulation Drill Hall and an Interactive Scenario Shooting Hall. The museum presents the development history of the police since the first police institution appeared in Shanghai in 1854, and houses a collection of more than 18,000 items dating from the late Qing Dynasty, of which 49 (sets) are national first-class cultural relics. The museum is a specialized science popularization venue in Shanghai and a Shanghai patriotism education base.

intro_en: The Power Station of Art is a contemporary art museum located on the banks of the Huangpu River in Huangpu District, Shanghai, People's Republic of China. It is the first state-run contemporary art museum in mainland China. It was formerly the Urban Future Pavilion of the 2010 Shanghai World Expo, and before that, the Nanshi Power Plant. The museum has a building area of over 40,000 square meters, with 15,000 square meters of exhibition space and 12 exhibition halls. Established on October 1, 2012, the Power Station of Art is also the main venue of the Shanghai Biennale.

intro_en: The Xiannongtan (Temple of Agriculture) architectural complex was where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties made offerings to the gods of agriculture and the Taisui deities and performed ritual plowing. Located west of the southern section of Beijing's central axis in Xicheng District, it faces the Temple of Heaven across to the east, echoing it from afar. It is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. On July 27, 2024, Xiannongtan was inscribed as a World Heritage Site as part of "Beijing Central Axis: A Building Ensemble Exhibiting the Ideal Order of the Chinese Capital."
address_en: Tiantan Subdistrict, Dongcheng District, Beijing

address: 北京市丰台区新村街道樊羊路125号首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
intro: 北京汽车博物馆是位于丰台区的北京国际汽车博览中心的核心建筑。北京国际汽车博览中心暨北京汽车博物馆工程被北京市人民政府列入2003年北京市60项重点工程，责成丰台区人民政府具体负责建设，丰台区人民政府为此专门组建“北京国际汽车博览中心建设办公室”。根据2002年10月18日北京市规划委员会批准的《规划意见书》，该项目选址丰台区花乡四合庄村，西临万寿路南延，北临南四环西路，总用地面积58公顷，地上建筑面积50余万平方米，总投资40亿元人民币。建成之后的北京国际汽车博览中心将包含北京汽车博物馆、销售馆、品牌馆、商务区、汽车主题公园等等。其中北京汽车博物馆是北京市重点建设的五大博物馆之一。
intro_en: The Beijing Auto Museum is the core building of the Beijing International Auto Expo Center located in Fengtai District. The Beijing International Auto Expo Center and Beijing Auto Museum project was listed by the Beijing Municipal People's Government as one of Beijing's 60 key projects in 2003, with the Fengtai District People's Government specifically entrusted with construction. For this purpose, the Fengtai District People's Government established the "Beijing International Auto Expo Center Construction Office." According to the Planning Opinion approved by the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission on October 18, 2002, the project site is located in Sihezhuang Village, Huaxiang, Fengtai District, bordered to the west by the southern extension of Wanshou Road and to the north by the West Fourth Ring Road South, with a total land area of 58 hectares, an above-ground building area of over 500,000 square meters, and a total investment of 4 billion RMB. Upon completion, the Beijing International Auto Expo Center will include the Beijing Auto Museum, a sales hall, a brand hall, a business district, an automobile theme park, and more. Among these, the Beijing Auto Museum is one of the five major museums prioritized for development by the city of Beijing.
address_en: Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, No. 125 Fanyang Road, Xincun Subdistrict, Fengtai District, Beijing

name_en: Confucius Temple and Imperial College Museum
address: 北京市东城区交道口街道东旺胡同北京市府学胡同小学
intro: 孔庙和国子监博物馆的前身是2005年3月成立的孔庙和国子监管理处。2008年6月，在孔庙和国子监管理处的基础上，成立了孔庙和国子监博物馆，作为专题性、历史类博物馆，直属北京市文物局。孔庙和国子监博物馆主要从事北京孔庙、国子监的保护和利用工作，开展孔子和科举制度等的研究工作。同时负责收集、整理、保管、陈列相关文物及文献。
name_aliases: ["国子监", "北京孔庙", "孔庙国子监", "成贤街孔庙"]
intro_en: The Confucian Temple and Imperial College Museum traces its origins to the Confucian Temple and Imperial College Administrative Office, established in March 2005. In June 2008, on the basis of this administrative office, the Confucian Temple and Imperial College Museum was founded as a specialized, history-oriented museum under the direct administration of the Beijing Municipal Administration of Cultural Heritage. The museum is mainly engaged in the protection and utilization of the Beijing Confucian Temple and the Imperial College, as well as research on Confucius and the imperial examination system. It is also responsible for collecting, organizing, preserving, and exhibiting related cultural relics and documents.
address_en: No. 30 Dongwang Hutong
opening_hours_en: today 09:00-17:00 open (last entry 16:30)

address: 北京市东城区景山街道中国美术馆
intro: 故宮博物院，又稱北京故宮，是位于中华人民共和国北京紫禁城内的博物館。民國元年（1912年）清帝溥仪退位後仍居於宮內。至民國十三年（1924年）十一月五日，黃郛攝政內閣公布修正清室優待條件第五條，廢除皇帝尊號，並將溥儀驅逐出宮。政府代表李煜瀛、京師警衛司令鹿鍾麟、警察總監張璧，於六日接管皇宮，封存文物。後經攝政內閣核准，經一年之整理，故宮博物院於民國十四年國慶節（1925年10月10日）正式成立開幕。它位于北京中轴线的中心，占地面积100余万平方米，建筑面积约15万平方米；始建于明成祖朱棣永乐四年（1406年），永乐十八年（1420年）落成；藏品也主要是以明、清两代皇宫及其收藏为基础。2012年单日最高客流量突破18万人次，全年客流量突破1500万人次 ，可以说是世界上接待游客最繁忙的博物馆。
intro_en: The Palace Museum, also known as the Beijing Palace Museum, is a museum located within the Forbidden City in Beijing, People's Republic of China. After the abdication of Emperor Puyi of the Qing dynasty in the first year of the Republic of China (1912), he continued to live within the palace. On November 5, the thirteenth year of the Republic (1924), Article 5 of the revised Articles of Favorable Treatment of the Qing House, promulgated by Huang Fu's regency cabinet, abolished the imperial title and expelled Puyi from the palace. On the sixth, government representatives Li Yuying, garrison commander Lu Zhonglin, and police director Zhang Bi took over the palace and sealed its cultural relics. With the approval of the regency cabinet, and after a year of preparation, the Palace Museum was officially established and opened on National Day of the fourteenth year of the Republic (October 10, 1925). Located at the center of Beijing's central axis, it covers an area of over 1 million square meters, with a floor area of about 150,000 square meters. Its construction began in 1406, the fourth year of the Yongle reign of Emperor Chengzu of the Ming dynasty (Zhu Di), and was completed in 1420, the eighteenth year of Yongle. Its collections are primarily based on the Ming and Qing imperial palaces and their collections. In 2012, its single-day visitor count exceeded 180,000, and annual visitors exceeded 15 million, making it arguably the busiest museum in the world by visitor reception.
address_en: National Art Museum of China, Jingshan Subdistrict, Dongcheng District, Beijing

address: 北京市海淀区清华园街道清华大学
opening_hours: 全年 周二–周日 09:00–17:00开放 最晚进入16:30；全年 周一 全天不开放；元旦节,清明节,劳动节,端午节,国庆节 09:00–17:00开放 最晚进入16:30；清华大学不对公众开放
intro: 清华大学艺术博物馆（冠名“黄如论馆”），位于北京市海淀区清华大学校內東南，是该校艺术博物馆。 此博物館由中国建筑科学研究院及馬里奧·博塔建筑师事务所联合设计，建築面積2萬9912平方公尺，高度25.331公尺 ，是中國最大的大學博物館 。2020年12月21日，清华大学艺术博物馆被評定為第四批國家一級博物館，是第一個大學博物馆成為晋级国家一级馆。
intro_en:
Location: Tsinghua University Art Museum
The Tsinghua University Art Museum (named "Huang Rulun Hall") is located in the southeast of the Tsinghua University campus in Haidian District, Beijing, and is the university's art museum. The museum was jointly designed by the China Academy of Building Research and Mario Botta Architetto, with a building area of 29,912 square meters and a height of 25.331 meters, making it the largest university museum in China. On December 21, 2020, the Tsinghua University Art Museum was designated as a National First-Class Museum in the fourth batch, becoming the first university museum to be promoted to national first-class status.
address_en: B2 Floor, Meng Minwei Humanities Building, Tsinghua University, Qinghuayuan Subdistrict

Location: Tsinghua University Art Museum

address: 江苏省南京市玄武区梅园新村街道地质大厦测试楼
opening_hours: 周三至周五:09:30-16:30(16:00停止入馆),周六至周日:09:00-16:30(16:00停止入馆)；周一、周二闭馆,法定节假日开放时间另行通知；节假日营业时间以官方通知为准
intro: 南京地质博物馆位于江苏省南京市玄武区珠江路700号。南京地质博物馆的前身是1913年在北京成立的中华民国临时政府农商部地质调查所地质矿产陈列室，是中国最早的自然科学博物馆、地质专业博物馆 。1935年陈列馆随地质调查所迁至南京，抗日战争期间一度西迁。中华人民共和国建立后，1952年改名地质部地质陈列馆，1957年改为地质部地质陈列馆南京分馆，1992年改现名。南京地质博物馆为国家二级博物馆、全国科普教育基地，隶属于江苏省国土资源厅、江苏省地质调查研究院。
intro_en:
Location: Nanjing Geological Museum
The Nanjing Geological Museum is located at 700 Zhujiang Road, Xuanwu District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. Its predecessor was the Geological and Mineral Exhibition Room of the Geological Survey of the Ministry of Agriculture and Commerce of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China, established in Beijing in 1913, making it China's earliest natural science museum and museum of geology. In 1935, the exhibition hall moved to Nanjing along with the Geological Survey, and was temporarily relocated westward during the War of Resistance Against Japan. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, it was renamed the Geological Exhibition Hall of the Ministry of Geology in 1952, became the Nanjing Branch of the Geological Exhibition Hall of the Ministry of Geology in 1957, and adopted its current name in 1992. The Nanjing Geological Museum is a National Second-Grade Museum and a National Science Popularization Education Base, affiliated with the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Land and Resources and the Jiangsu Geological Survey Institute.
address_en: Geology Building, No. 700 Zhujiang Road
opening_hours_en: Wed-Fri: 09:30-16:30 (last entry at 16:00), Sat-Sun: 09:00-16:30 (last entry at 16:00); closed on Mondays and Tuesdays; opening hours on public holidays will be announced separately; holiday hours are subject to official notices.

address: 江苏省南京市秦淮区夫子庙街道边营老门东
intro: 南京城墙博物馆位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市秦淮区新民坊路边营1号，毗邻南京城墙中华门和南京门东历史风貌区，是以南京城墙为主要展览对象的一座专题博物馆。南京城墙博物馆占地面积6681.4平方米、总建筑面积13089.3平方米，由何镜堂领衔华南理工大学建筑设计研究院设计。博物馆不仅内有2500多件藏品，还在外部设置半透明夹丝玻璃幕墙和长达50米的坡道与屋顶平台，使博物馆与周围城墙、南京城南风光相互交融，成为一处开放的观景平台。
intro_en: The Nanjing City Wall Museum is located at 1 Bianying, Xinminfang Road, Qinhuai District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. Adjacent to the Zhonghua Gate of the Nanjing City Wall and the Men East Historical and Cultural District of Nanjing, it is a specialized museum with the Nanjing City Wall as its main exhibition subject. The Nanjing City Wall Museum covers a site area of 6,681.4 square meters, with a total floor area of 13,089.3 square meters, and was designed by a team led by He Jingtang from the Architectural Design and Research Institute of South China University of Technology. The museum houses more than 2,500 artifacts. In addition, its exterior features a translucent wire glass curtain wall, a 50-meter-long ramp, and a rooftop platform, blending the museum with the surrounding city wall and the scenery of southern Nanjing, making it an open viewing platform.
address_en: Nanjing City Wall Museum
opening_hours_en: Tuesday–Sunday 09:00-17:00 last entry 16:30

address: 陕西省咸阳市兴平市南位镇茂陵博物馆
intro: 茂陵博物馆，位于中华人民共和国陕西省咸阳市兴平市南位镇汉武帝茂陵东侧霍去病墓园内，以汉武帝茂陵、霍去病墓及大型石刻群等为主的西汉断代史博物馆，国家二级博物馆。该馆前身为1956年成立的茂陵文物保管所，1979年12月晋升为博物馆。该馆占地面积49.2万平方米，建筑面积16159平方米，馆藏文物4100余件，为事业单位，隶属于兴平市文化和旅游局。
address_en: Maoling Museum, Nanwei Town, Xingping City, Xianyang, Shaanxi, China

address_en: Side Road of Renmin Avenue, Shuguang Road Subdistrict, Beiguan District, Anyang City, Henan Province, China

opening_hours: 周二至周日09:00-17:00(16:30 停止入馆),周一闭馆（法定节假日除外),(数据来源:江苏省文旅厅公共服务平台苏心游)
intro: 1936年8月竣工的国立美术陈列馆，是中国近现代第一座国家级美术馆 。1937年4月，举办“中華民國教育部第二次全国美术展览”，并正式追称1929年在上海谱育堂举办的美展为第一次第二次全国美术展览。同年12月，南京沦陷，一切美术活动停止。至1949年政权更迭，“中華民國教育部第二次全国美术展览”是国立美术陈列馆唯一举办的美术展览 。

intro_en:
Location: Jiangsu Provincial Art Museum

Completed in August 1936, the National Art Gallery was the first national-level art museum in modern China. In April 1937, it hosted the "Second National Art Exhibition of the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China," and retroactively designated the art exhibition held at Puyutang in Shanghai in 1929 as the First National Art Exhibition. In December of the same year, Nanjing fell, and all art activities ceased. Until the regime change in 1949, the "Second National Art Exhibition of the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China" remained the only art exhibition ever held at the National Art Gallery.

intro: 内蒙古博物院，旧名内蒙古博物馆，位于中华人民共和国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市赛罕区中专路街道新华东街76号，与内蒙古乌兰恰特大剧院毗邻。馆舍主体建筑面积5万余平方米，由陈列展厅区、文物库房区、观众服务区、业务科研区及多功能厅等各部分组成。
intro_en: The Inner Mongolia Museum, formerly known as the Inner Mongolia Museum (old name), is located at No. 76 Xinhua East Street, Zhongzhuan Road Subdistrict, Saihan District, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China, adjacent to the Inner Mongolia Wulanqiat Grand Theatre. The main building of the museum covers an area of more than 50,000 square meters and consists of exhibition halls, cultural relic storage areas, visitor service areas, academic and research areas, and multifunctional halls, among other sections.

address: 辽宁省大连市沙河口区黑石礁街道大连自然博物馆
intro: 大连自然博物馆位于中华人民共和国辽宁省大连市沙河口区黑石礁西村街40号，是一座集地质、古生物、动物、植物标本收藏、研究、展示于一体的综合性自然科学博物馆，其前身始建于1907年。新馆为现代欧式建筑，建筑面积1.5万平方米，展览面积1万平方米，是国内唯一拥有27万平方米海域的博物馆。2018年，大连自然博物馆被评为中国首批甲级古生物化石收藏单位，2020年被评为国家一级博物馆 。
address_en: Dalian Natural History Museum, Heishijiao Subdistrict, Shahekou District, Dalian, Liaoning, China

address: 广东省广州市荔湾区金花街道陈家祠堂(西门)广东民间工艺博物馆
intro: 陈家祠（陈氏书院）位於中华人民共和国广东省广州市荔湾区金花街道陈家祠社区中山七路恩龙里34号，始建于清朝光绪十四年（1888年），是当时广东省七十二县陈姓宗亲合资兴建的合族宗祠。陈家祠是集岭南历代建筑艺术之大成的典型代表，以装饰精巧、堂皇富丽而著称于世。现辟为广东民间工艺博物馆。
name_aliases: ["陈家祠", "陈氏书院", "陈氏书院（陈家祠）"]
intro_en: Chen Clan Ancestral Hall (Chen Clan Academy) is located at No. 34 Enlong Lane, Zhongshan 7th Road, Chenjiaci Community, Jinhua Subdistrict, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, the People's Republic of China. Construction began in the 14th year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1888). It was an ancestral hall for the entire Chen clan, jointly funded by Chen clan relatives from 72 counties of Guangdong Province. The Chen Clan Ancestral Hall is a representative masterpiece that embodies the architectural art of Lingnan through the dynasties, renowned worldwide for its exquisite decoration and magnificent splendor. It now houses the Guangdong Folk Art Museum.

intro: 广州艺术博物院（广州美术馆），是中華人民共和國廣東省廣州市的大型多功能綜合性藝術博物館，坐落于广州城市新中轴线之上，北望广州塔，西邻赤岗塔，南接在建的广州科学馆，项目总投资约20.94亿元 ，是中国唯一兼有“国家重点美术馆”和“国家一级博物馆”称号的艺术机构。
review_summary: 评分高达4.6，坐落广州新中轴线、毗邻广州塔，兼具国家重点美术馆与国家一级博物馆双资质，艺术爱好者打卡胜地。
intro_en:
Location: Guangzhou Museum of Art

The Guangzhou Museum of Art (Guangzhou Art Museum) is a large multi-functional comprehensive art museum in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, the People's Republic of China. It is situated on the city's new central axis, facing Canton Tower to the north, adjacent to Chigang Pagoda to the west, and bordering the Guangzhou Science Museum (under construction) to the south. With a total project investment of approximately 2.094 billion yuan, it is the only art institution in China holding both the titles of "National Key Art Museum" and "National First-Class Museum."

review_summary_en: Rating as high as 4.6, located on Guangzhou's new central axis and adjacent to Canton Tower, it holds dual qualifications as a National Key Art Gallery and a National First-Class Museum—a must-visit destination for art lovers.

address: 广东省广州市越秀区洪桥街道越秀公园
intro: 广州博物馆，位于中国广东省广州市的综合性博物馆，为华南地区首座公立博物馆，亦是中国最早成立的博物馆之一，主馆址为广州镇海楼，现为国家一级博物馆，下辖仲元楼、三元里人民抗英斗争纪念馆、三·二九起义指挥部旧址纪念馆 。馆名由书画家吴子复题写 ，主馆址前的红色石壁馆名由广东民间工艺博物馆馆长李卓祺所题。

intro_en: The Guangzhou Museum is a comprehensive museum located in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China. It was the first public museum in South China and one of the earliest museums established in China. Its main building is housed in the Zhenhai Tower in Guangzhou, and it is now a National First-Grade Museum. It also administers the Zhongyuan Tower, the Sanyuanli People's Anti-British Struggle Memorial Hall, and the Memorial Hall of the Former Headquarters of the March 29 Uprising. The museum's name was inscribed by the calligrapher and painter Wu Zifu, while the name on the red stone wall in front of the main building was inscribed by Li Zhuoqi, director of the Guangdong Folk Art Museum.

intro_en: The Liangzhu Museum is located at No. 1 Meilizhou Road, Liangzhu Subdistrict, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China, within Meilizhou Park. It is a specialized museum dedicated to the exhibition, display, and research of Liangzhu culture, and its predecessor was the Liangzhu Culture Museum, which was established and opened in 1994. Construction of the new building began in March 2005, and it opened to the public in October 2008; the museum's name was inscribed by Jiang Zemin. In August 2017, based on the latest archaeological findings on the Liangzhu Site and Liangzhu culture, the museum's permanent exhibition was renovated and upgraded, and it reopened to the public in June 2018.

review_summary_en: Liangzhu Museum is a hidden gem in Hangzhou for taking kids out, perfect for family fun. It is also a great spot for flower viewing—bringing your children here means they can both play happily and enjoy the flowers together, full of fun.

intro_en: The Changyu Wine Culture Museum is located in downtown Yantai. Built on the foundation of the century-old Changyu wine brand, the museum showcases winemaking history, historic buildings, and underground wine cellars. Visitors can tour the museum and taste wine, making it a well-known place to learn about Chinese wine culture.

intro_en: Construction began in November 2013, and the museum was completed and opened to the public on May 18, 2016. It was designed and built by Liu Jiakun, with the museum's name inscribed by Yu Qiuyu. It mainly consists of a main hall and a heritage park, with three exhibition halls, covering a site area of 38,875 square meters and a floor area of 15,087 square meters. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, Lumu Yuyao Village fired the golden bricks used for the Palace Museum and the Summer Palace; the imperial kiln ruins still exist today.

address: 青海省西宁市城西区古城台街道交通巷45号青海省博物馆
intro: 1957年，第一次成立青海省博物馆筹备处，1962年撤销。1978年8月29日，再次成立青海省博物馆筹备处。1986年9月26日，青海省博物馆正式建馆并且对外开放。馆址设在西宁市城东区为民巷41号原青海军阀马步芳私宅“馨庐”。1996年9月，青海省博物馆被中共青海省委、青海省人民政府命名为“省级爱国主义教育基地”。同年10月，被青海省教育委员会命名为“学校德育教育基地”。1997年，被国家文物局评选为文博系统“全国爱国主义教育基地”。2001年5月1日，青海省博物馆新馆对外开放。新馆在西宁市城西区西关大街58号，新宁广场的东侧，新馆占地面积17000平方米，建筑面积20800平方米。新馆内设展厅9个，展陈面积9146平方米 。

intro: 河南博物院位于中华人民共和国河南省郑州市金水区文化路街道农业路8号，是一所国家级的大型现代化综合博物馆，国家级重点博物院之一，前身是河南省博物馆。河南省博物院是中国近代较早创立的博物馆，自民國十六年在冯玉祥的主导下建立，距今已有八十多年历史，抗日战争期间，河南博物院的部分珍贵文物几经辗转最终被珍藏在台湾国立历史博物馆。大陸的河南博物院馆址几经变更，最初的馆址位于开封市龙亭区三胜街31号，1961年搬迁至郑州市。目前的馆舍于1997年开放。

address: 湖南省长沙市芙蓉区文艺路街道韭菜园路125号湖南古玩城B座

address_en: Beijing Planetarium, Zhanlanlu Subdistrict, Xicheng District, Beijing, China

intro: 北京野生动物园位于北京大兴区，是一座大型野生动物园，游客可乘车或步行近距离观赏各种野生动物，兼具游览观光与科普教育功能，是亲子出游的热门去处。

name_zh: 周口店北京人遗址博物馆
address: 周口店周胜路
intro: 周口店北京人遗址博物馆位于北京市房山区，依托世界文化遗产周口店遗址而建，展示北京人头盖骨复制品、石器等展品，是了解远古人类演化的科普场所。
intro_en: The Zhoukoudian Peking Man Site Museum is located in Fangshan District, Beijing. Built around the Zhoukoudian Site, a World Cultural Heritage site, it displays exhibits such as replicas of Peking Man skullcaps and stone tools, making it a science education venue for learning about early human evolution.
address_en: Zhousheng Road, Zhoukoudian
opening_hours_en: Open 09:00-16:30 Tuesday-Sunday, April 1 to October 10; Open 09:00-16:00 Tuesday-Sunday, October 11 to March 31; Closed all day on Mondays year-round; Open 09:00-16:00 on Chinese public holidays.

address: 北京市东城区天坛街道天坛公园
intro: 天坛（ ），位于北京市东城区，是明清两朝皇帝祭天、祈穀和祈雨的场所。天坛始建于明成祖永乐十八年（公元1420年），原名“天地坛”，明嘉靖九年（公元1530年）在北京北郊另建祭祀地神的地坛，并改名为“天坛”。
review_tags: ["遛娃宝藏地", "亲子同乐", "赏花胜地", "历史建筑", "夜游观景"]
name_aliases: ["北京市天坛公园", "北京天坛", "天坛"]
review_summary: 天坛公园是遛娃宝藏地，适合亲子同乐；这里既是赏花胜地，又保留历史建筑可供观赏，夜间还能体验夜游观景。
intro_en: The Temple of Heaven ( ), located in Dongcheng District, Beijing, was the site where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties offered sacrifices to Heaven and prayed for grain and rain. Construction of the Temple of Heaven began in the 18th year of the Yongle reign of Emperor Chengzu of the Ming Dynasty (1420 AD), originally under the name "Temple of Heaven and Earth." In the 9th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1530 AD), the Temple of Earth, dedicated to the God of Earth, was built in the northern suburbs of Beijing, and the original site was renamed the "Temple of Heaven."
address_en: Temple of Heaven Park, Tiantan Subdistrict, Dongcheng District, Beijing, China
review_tags_en: ["A hidden gem for taking kids out", "Family fun with kids", "Flower viewing spot", "Historic buildings", "Night sightseeing"]
review_summary_en:
Location: Temple of Heaven Park
Temple of Heaven Park is a hidden gem for taking kids out, perfect for family fun; it is both a flower-viewing spot and home to historical buildings to admire, and you can also enjoy a night tour there in the evening.

intro: 明孝陵博物馆位于中国江苏省南京市玄武区中山门外四方城1号、明孝陵景区大金门入口东南侧，为展示明孝陵及其所代表的明文化的专题博物馆，馆址最初设于梅花山暗香阁，现馆址为利用原南京手表厂部分旧厂房改造而成，2009年2月对外开放 ，基本陈列为《大明孝陵》（分为孝陵雄姿、传奇帝王、选址建陵、创新规制、历史地位、孝陵沧桑等六个部分），并设有明式家具馆、织锦馆、茶艺馆和360度环幕影院等 。
intro_en: The Ming Xiaoling Museum is located at No. 1 Sifangcheng, outside Zhongshan Gate, Xuanwu District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China, on the southeast side of the Great Golden Gate entrance of the Ming Xiaoling Scenic Area. It is a thematic museum showcasing the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum and the Ming culture it represents. The museum was originally housed in the Anxiang Pavilion at Meihua Mountain (Plum Blossom Hill); its current site was converted from part of the former Nanjing Watch Factory buildings and opened to the public in February 2009. Its permanent exhibition, "The Great Ming Xiaoling," consists of six sections: the Grandeur of Xiaoling, the Legendary Emperor, Site Selection and Mausoleum Construction, Innovative Regulations, Historical Status, and the Vicissitudes of Xiaoling. The museum also features a Ming-style Furniture Hall, a Brocade Hall, a Tea Art Hall, and a 360-degree circular-screen theater.
address_en: Xihuamei Road Community, No. 6656 Qixin Road, Xinhong Subdistrict, Minhang District, Shanghai, China

address: 新民坊路边营1号
intro: 南京城墙博物馆位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市秦淮区新民坊路边营1号，毗邻南京城墙中华门和南京门东历史风貌区，是以南京城墙为主要展览对象的一座专题博物馆。南京城墙博物馆占地面积6681.4平方米、总建筑面积13089.3平方米，由何镜堂领衔华南理工大学建筑设计研究院设计。博物馆不仅内有2500多件藏品，还在外部设置半透明夹丝玻璃幕墙和长达50米的坡道与屋顶平台，使博物馆与周围城墙、南京城南风光相互交融，成为一处开放的观景平台。
intro_en: The Nanjing City Wall Museum is located at No. 1 Bianying, Xinminfang Road, Qinhuai District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China, adjacent to Zhonghua Gate of the Nanjing City Wall and the Nanjing Mendong Historic Area. It is a specialized museum with the Nanjing City Wall as its principal subject of exhibition. The Nanjing City Wall Museum covers a site area of 6,681.4 square meters and a total floor area of 13,089.3 square meters, and was designed by the Architectural Design and Research Institute of South China University of Technology
address_en: No. 1 Xinyingfang Road
opening_hours_en: Tuesday to Sunday 09:00-17:00, last entry 16:30

intro: 赛里木湖位于新疆博尔塔拉州，是天山山脉中的高山湖泊，湖水清澈湛蓝，四周雪峰环抱、草原辽阔，风光壮美，被誉为“大西洋最后一滴眼泪”，是著名的自然风景旅游胜地。

intro_en: Dali Scenic Area is a scenic area in Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province. In 1982, it was included by the State Council in the first batch of national scenic areas. In 2007, it was named one of the "Ten Most Distinctive Scenic Areas in China."

intro_en: Mount Emei Museum, located at the foot of Mount Emei in Sichuan, is a regional museum showcasing Mount Emei's geological evolution, biodiversity, and Buddhist history and culture. It is an important window for visitors to learn about the natural and cultural heritage of Mount Emei.

opening_hours: 10/08 周四 全天不开放；01/01-12/31 周二–周三, 周五–周日 08:45–16:45开放 最晚进入15:30；01/01-10/07 周四 08:45–16:45开放 最晚进入15:30；10/09-12/31 周四 08:45–16:45开放 最晚进入15:30；01/01-12/31 周一 全天不开放；国庆节,元旦节,春节,清明节,劳动节,中秋节,端午节 08:45–16:45开放 最晚进入15:30；逢国定节假日则顺延至节后第一个工作日闭馆
intro: 上海儿童博物馆成立于1996年5月29日，占地面积9000平方米，建筑面积4500平方米，地上有三层，另有地下一层，建筑外形为长方体、球体、三角体所组成。博物馆主要有两个展区，分别是主题科学展示区和互动探索区。主题科学展示区主要对一些儿童感兴趣的专题进行介绍，包括航海、航天、天文、月球、信息技术、环保等。在互动探索区内设有树屋，儿童也可以穿上各行业的制服，扮演警察、医生等角色，另外还有一个小型剧场，专供小游客上台进行表演。另外还有主题展览区和儿童阅读区，为游客提供了网络和书籍，供消遣时间 。
intro_en:
Location: Shanghai Children's Museum

Founded on May 29, 1996, the Shanghai Children's Museum covers an area of 9,000 square meters, with a building area of 4,500 square meters. It has three floors above ground and one basement level, and its building is composed of rectangular, spherical, and triangular shapes. The museum has two main exhibition areas: the Themed Science Exhibition Area and the Interactive Exploration Area. The Themed Science Exhibition Area introduces topics of interest to children, including navigation, aerospace, astronomy, the moon, information technology, and environmental protection. In the Interactive Exploration Area, there is a tree house, and children can also put on uniforms of various professions and play roles such as police officers and doctors. There is also a small theater exclusively for young visitors to perform on stage. In addition, there is a themed exhibition area and a children's reading area, providing visitors with internet access and books for leisure.
address_en: No. 61 Songyuan Road
opening_hours_en: Oct 08 (Thu): Closed all day; Jan 01–Dec 31 Tue–Wed, Fri–Sun 08:45–16:45 (last entry 15:30); Jan 01–Oct 07 Thu 08:45–16:45 (last entry 15:30); Oct 09–Dec 31 Thu 08:45–16:45 (last entry 15:30); Jan 01–Dec 31 Mon: Closed all day; National Day, New Year's Day, Spring Festival, Qingming Festival, Labor Day, Mid-Autumn Festival, Dragon Boat Festival 08:45–16:45 (last entry 15:30); When a public holiday falls on a Monday, the museum closes on the first working day after the holiday instead

intro: 罗布人村寨位于新疆巴音郭楞尉犁县，地处塔里木河畔，是罗布人后裔聚居的村落，展示独特的罗布人民俗风情，兼有沙漠、胡杨林与水域交融的自然风光。
intro_en: Luobu People Village is located in Yuli County, Bayingolin, Xinjiang, on the banks of the Tarim River. It is a village inhabited by the descendants of the Lop people, showcasing the unique folk customs of the Lop people, and featuring natural scenery where desert, populus euphratica forests, and waters blend together.
address_en: Bayingolin (Bayanbulag) Township, Hejing County, Bayingolin Mongol Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang

intro: 桃花源风景名胜区位于湖南常德，因陶渊明《桃花源记》中描绘的世外桃源而得名，区内有田园、溪流、桃林等景观，是集自然风光与人文传说于一体的著名旅游胜地。
intro_en: Taohuayuan Scenic Area is located in Changde, Hunan. It is named after the paradise depicted in Tao Yuanming's "The Peach Blossom Spring". The area features landscapes such as pastoral fields, streams, and peach groves, making it a renowned tourist destination that integrates natural scenery with cultural legends.
address_en: Taohuayuan Town, Taoyuan County, Changde City, Hunan Province

intro: 白云山风景名胜区位于广州市区北部，是广州著名的自然风景区，素有“羊城第一秀”之称，山上林木葱郁，可登高俯瞰广州城景，是市民休闲游览的好去处。
address_en: Jingxi Subdistrict, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, Baiyun Mountain Scenic Area, Guangzhou Baiyun Mountain Scenic Area

address: 湖南省张家界市武陵源区锣鼓塔街道金鞭路张家界国家森林公园
intro: 武陵源风景名胜区，简称武陵源，地处湖南省西北部的武陵山脉中段桑植和慈利两县交界处，隶属张家界市。武陵源由四大风景区组成，分别为张家界国家森林公园和张家界国家地质公园、索溪峪、天子山、杨家界三个自然保护区；总面积约391平方公里，核心景区面积超过250平方公里。武陵源具有比较原始的生态系统，有罕见的砂岩峰林地貌:丁工景观，有3000多座形状奇异的山峰、800多条溪涧，也有岩溶洞穴、瀑布群，并有天然森林，1980年代初被开辟为旅游景区，1988年被定为国家重点风景名胜区，并建立武陵源区政府。1992年12月，被联合国教科文组织作为自然遗产列入《世界遗产名录》。
address_en: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Jinbian Road, Luoguta Subdistrict, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

address_en: Yufeng Street, Wufeng Town, Jintang County, Chengdu, Sichuan, China

intro: 龙门山风景名胜区位于成都市西北部，龙门山中段，山势雄奇，峡谷幽深，拥有飞瀑、溶洞、森林等自然景观，是成都周边登山休闲、避暑观光的好去处。
address_en: Longmenshan Town Government, No. 331 Fuxing Road, Longmenshan Town, Pengzhou City, Chengdu, Sichuan, China

intro: 蔚州博物馆，即蔚县博物馆，位于中华人民共和国河北省张家口市蔚县蔚州镇通元路，是一个综合地志博物馆，也是国家二级博物馆。蔚州博物馆成立于1958年，早期选址于清代四合院，后迁入释迦寺，2016年从释迦寺迁至通元路新馆。如今的蔚州博物馆建筑面积13000平方米，展厅面积6000平方米。

address_en: Wutaishan Scenic Area, Parking Lot (Southeast of Yongbang Tianhui), Taihuai Town, Wutai County, Xinzhou, Shanxi

The Sichuan University Museum, located on the Wangjiang Campus, is a comprehensive university museum. The Suzhou Garden Museum is located at No. 202 Dongbei Street, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. It is China's first thematic museum showcasing garden culture, founded in 1992, with its site being the former residential part of the Humble Administrator's Garden. It is a comprehensive regional museum, and in November 2012 it was designated as a National First-Class Museum by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. name_en: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
address: 陕西省西安市临潼区秦陵街道演艺广场秦始皇帝陵
opening_hours: 08:30-17:00, 具体开放时间以现场公示为准
intro: 秦始皇帝陵是秦朝開國皇帝秦始皇的陵墓，位於中華人民共和國陝西省西安市臨潼區驪山北麓，秦代稱驪山園。陵園以封土和地下墓室為中心，設內外城垣，周圍分布禮制建築、陪葬墓、陪葬坑和修陵人墓地等遺存；核心地宮至今未作主動發掘。陵園東側的兵馬俑坑於1974年被發現，其陶俑、戰車和兵器展示了秦代軍事編制、雕塑和工藝。
intro_en:
Location: Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang
The Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang is the tomb of Qin Shi Huang, the founding emperor of the Qin dynasty. It is located at the northern foot of Mount Li in Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and was known in the Qin dynasty as Lishan Garden. The mausoleum complex centers on the burial mound and underground tomb chamber, enclosed by inner and outer city walls, with surrounding remains including ritual buildings, attendant tombs, burial pits, and a cemetery for the tomb builders; the core underground palace has never been actively excavated. The Terracotta Army pits to the east of the mausoleum were discovered in 1974; their terracotta figures, chariots, and weapons showcase Qin dynasty military organization, sculpture, and craftsmanship.
address_en: Yanyi Square, Qinling Subdistrict, Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi (Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site)
opening_hours_en: 08:30-17:00, hours subject to on-site notice

intro_en: Qianfoshan (Thousand Buddha Mountain) is located in the southern part of Jinan's urban area and is one of Jinan's three major scenic spots. The mountain features historical sites such as Xingguo Chan Temple and the Thousand Buddha Cliff, with numerous Buddhist statues. From the summit, visitors can overlook the entire "City of Springs." It is a popular destination for locals' leisure and mountain climbing.

intro_en: The Xiushanmen Museum is located in Chizhou, Anhui. It is a private museum set against the backdrop of an ancient city gate. Its collection mainly features the three Huizhou carving arts, ancient architectural components, and folk relics, showcasing local history and culture. It is a great place to visit in Chizhou to learn about the local cultural customs.

address: 湖北省武汉市江夏区金港新区街道蛇山
intro: 黄鹤楼位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市武昌蛇山上，与湖南岳阳楼、江西滕王阁合称江南三大名楼，是中国国家旅游胜地四十佳之一。黄鹤楼被称为“天下绝景”，这一称谓源自宋徽宗的一幅画“天下绝景黄鹤楼”。始建于三国时代吴黄武二年（公元223年），自初代開始，距今已有1800年历史，历代屡修屡毁，上一代為三層式，毀於1884年，黄鹤楼原址靠近江边，被选用为武汉长江公铁两用大桥的引桥起点，现在的黄鹤楼是于1985年异址重建的。最新一代版黄鹤楼共5层，高51.4米。
intro_en:
Location: Yellow Crane Tower
The Yellow Crane Tower is located on Snake Hill in Wuchang, Wuhan, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China. Together with Yueyang Tower in Hunan and Tengwang Pavilion in Jiangxi, it is known as one of the Three Great Towers of Jiangnan, and it is one of China's Top 40 National Tourist Attractions. The Yellow Crane Tower is called "A Marvel Under Heaven," a title derived from a painting by Emperor Huizong of Song titled "Yellow Crane Tower, A Marvel Under Heaven." First built in the second year of the Huangwu era of the Wu Kingdom during the Three Kingdoms period (223 AD), the tower has a history of 1,800 years since its first construction. It was repeatedly repaired and destroyed over the dynasties. The previous tower was a three-story structure, destroyed in 1884. The original site of the Yellow Crane Tower was close to the river and was chosen as the starting point of the approach bridge of the Wuhan Yangtze River road-rail bridge. The current Yellow Crane Tower was rebuilt at a new site in 1985. The latest version of the tower has 5 stories and stands 51.4 meters tall.
address_en: No. Te-1, West Hillside of Snake Mountain (500m walk from Exit A, Simenkou Huanghelou Metro Station), Wuchang District, Wuhan, Hubei, China

opening_hours: 5月20日至10月18日 周一,周三至周日 09:00-20:00,最晚进入19:00；周二 闭馆；9月25日至9月27日 09:00-20:00,最晚进入19:00；10月1日至10月7日 09:00-20:00,最晚进入19:00；具体开放时间以官方通知为准
intro: 1953年，北京市副市长吴晗、中央人民政府文化部社会文化事业管理局局长郑振铎访问苏联期间参观了“莫斯科历史与建设博物馆”。回国后两人提议筹建首都历史与建设博物馆。4月27日，在西长安街的北京市政府东厅，吴晗和郑振铎召开了关于建立“首都历史与建设博物馆”的座谈会，叶恭绰、邢赞亭、常任侠、侯仁之、王松声、马衡、常惠、傅振伦、刘开渠、苏秉琦、启功、何达、萧军等20余位历史、文化、教育、艺术界名人及文化部文物局业务秘书罗哲文等工作人员参加。1954年2月，北京市政府批准成立“首都历史与建设博物馆筹备处”。编制8人，起初在北海公园画舫斋与北京市文物调查研究组合署办公，后迁至北海公园天王殿。北京市政府还将天坛公园七十二长廊和宰牲亭划归筹备处作为展览地点。文化部从湖南、天津、四川、山东、云南、上海、重庆等地博物馆抽调业务干部支援筹备处的建馆和陈列工作。吴晗亲自主持召开了关于“首都历史与建设展览”的座谈会，会后筹备处开始编写首都社会主义建设时期陈列大纲。1957年“反右运动”开始，各地博物馆借调人员陆续返回，陈列计划落空 。
intro_en: In 1953, during a visit to the Soviet Union, Wu Han, Deputy Mayor of Beijing, and Zheng Zhenduo, Director of the Bureau of Social and Cultural Affairs under the Ministry of Culture of the Central People's Government, visited the "Moscow Museum of History and Reconstruction." After returning to China, the two proposed the establishment of the Capital Museum of History and Reconstruction. On April 27, in the east hall of the Beijing Municipal Government on West Chang'an Avenue, Wu Han and Zheng Zhenduo held a symposium on establishing the "Capital Museum of History and Reconstruction," attended by more than 20 renowned figures from history, culture, education, and the arts—including Ye Gongchuo, Xing Zanting, Chang Renxia, Hou Renzhi, Wang Songsheng, Ma Heng, Chang Hui, Fu Zhenlun, Liu Kaiqu, Su Bingqi, Qi Gong, He Da, and Xiao Jun—as well as staff such as Luo Zhewen, professional secretary of the Cultural Relics Bureau of the Ministry of Culture. In February 1954, the Beijing Municipal Government approved the establishment of the "Preparatory Office of the Capital Museum of History and Reconstruction." With a staff of 8, the office initially shared premises with the Beijing Cultural Relics Investigation and Research Group at Huafang Studio in Beihai Park, and later moved to the Hall of the Heavenly King in Beihai Park. The Beijing Municipal Government also designated the Seventy-Two-Corridor Long Corridor and the Slaughter Pavilion in the Temple of Heaven Park as exhibition venues for the preparatory office. The Ministry of Culture transferred professional personnel from museums in Hunan, Tianjin, Sichuan, Shandong, Yunnan, Shanghai, and Chongqing to support the office's museum-building and exhibition work. Wu Han personally chaired a symposium on the "Capital History and Reconstruction Exhibition," after which the preparatory office began drafting an exhibition outline for the period of socialist construction in the capital. When the "Anti-Rightist Movement" began in 1957, the personnel seconded from various museums gradually returned, and the exhibition plan came to nothing.
address_en: No.16 Fuxingmenwai Street

Location: Ancient City Museum, Dapeng New District, Shenzhen

Located in Dapeng New District, Shenzhen, this museum is established on the site of Dapeng Fortress, a Ming Dynasty coastal defense stronghold. It showcases the history of the ancient city and coastal defense culture, and Shenzhen's nickname "Pengcheng" originates here.

intro_en:
Location: Hu Qing Yu Tang Chinese Medicine Museum
The Hu Qing Yu Tang Chinese Medicine Museum is located in Hangzhou. Founded by Hu Xueyan, a merchant of the late Qing Dynasty, it is housed in a well-preserved Qing Dynasty pharmacy building and showcases traditional Chinese medicine culture and traditional pharmaceutical craftsmanship, earning it the reputation of the "King of Medicine in Jiangnan."

The Shanghai Aerospace Science Popularization Center, located at 7900 Humin Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, is an aviation and aerospace-themed museum featuring the display of many real aircraft.

Themed around traditional Chinese medicine culture, it houses a rich collection of Chinese medicinal herb specimens and medical history artifacts, making it a great place to learn about the history and knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine.

The Sifang Art Museum is located in Pukou District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. It is an art museum—a non-profit, private, multifunctional institution dedicated to the exhibition, preservation, research, and education of contemporary art and architecture.

The museum's collection contains more than 13,000 items. In 1998, the "Central Academy of Fine Arts Exhibition Hall" was renamed the "CAFA Art Museum." The Beijing Stone Carving Art Museum, located in Haidian District, was built on the former site of Zhenjue Temple (commonly known as Wuta Temple). It is famous for its Vajrasana Pagoda and collects and displays various stone relics such as steles and stone carvings.

The Shennong Caotang Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine is located in Guangzhou. It is a museum themed on traditional Chinese medicine culture, with a wide variety of medicinal plants grown on its grounds. Integrating herbal medicine displays, cultural education, and sightseeing, the museum is named after Shennong, the legendary figure who tasted hundreds of herbs.

intro_en: The China National Film Museum, located at 9 Nanying Road, Caochangdi Village, Cuigezhuang Area, Chaoyang District, Beijing, is currently the world's largest national-level museum dedicated to film. It is a landmark building commemorating the 100th anniversary of the birth of Chinese cinema. The China National Film Museum is a public institution directly under the Beijing Municipal People's Government. Jointly built by the State Administration of Radio, Film and Television and the Beijing Municipal People's Government, it covers an area of 52 mu with a building area of 37,930 square meters.

The China National Tea Museum is a museum in Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, dedicated to tea and tea culture. The museum has two branches, located in Shuangfeng Village and Longjing Village. It officially opened to the public in April 1991 and has been listed as a National First-Class Museum by the Chinese Museums Association.

Jiulong Lake Resort is located in Huadu District, Guangzhou. Centered around Jiulong Lake, it combines lake and mountain scenery, a European-style town, golf and other leisure activities, making it a great destination for a getaway on the outskirts of Guangzhou.

intro_en:
Location: Dayuanxiang Museum
Located in Bishan District, Chongqing, it is a private museum renowned for its collection of ancient architectural components from the Ming and Qing dynasties, housing a large number of treasures of traditional architectural art such as carved wooden doors and windows and stone-carved plaques.

intro: 北京东岳庙，位于中国北京市朝阳区朝阳门外大街141号，是道教正一派在华北地区的第一大丛林，现同时为北京民俗博物馆。庙内保存了大量各具特色的道教建筑和历代碑刻，对研究中国古代道教以及玄教的历史渊源和发展具有重要的参考价值。
intro_en:
Location: Beijing Folk Customs Museum

The Beijing Dongyue Temple, located at 141 Chaoyangmenwai Street, Chaoyang District, Beijing, China, is the largest Zhengyi Taoist monastery in North China and now also serves as the Beijing Folk Customs Museum. The temple preserves a large number of distinctive Taoist buildings and stone inscriptions from various dynasties, which are of important reference value for the study of the historical origins and development of ancient Chinese Taoism and the Xuanjiao sect.
address_en: Qmex Bar & Grill, South Sanlitun, Sanlitun Subdistrict, Chaoyang District, Beijing

The Fairy Lake Botanical Garden is located in Luohu District, Shenzhen, integrating plant collection, scientific research and education, and leisure sightseeing. The West Lake Museum is located at 89 Nanshan Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, the People's Republic of China, right next to the Qian Wang Temple. intro_en: Jinshanzui Fishing Village is located on the northern shore of Hangzhou Bay in Jinshan District, Shanghai. Known as "Shanghai's last fishing village," it is famous for its long-standing fishing traditions and seafood cuisine, making it a great place to experience authentic fishing village charm and seaside leisure.

Location: Civil Aviation Museum of China
The Civil Aviation Museum is located on the Capital Airport auxiliary road, Chaoyang District, Beijing, the People's Republic of China. It is the only civil aviation themed museum directly affiliated with the Civil Aviation Administration of China. It officially opened on November 21, 2011. In addition to the main museum in Beijing, it currently has branch museums at Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport, Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Lanzhou Zhongchuan International Airport, Jiayuguan Airport, Civil Aviation University of China, and the Second Research Institute of CAAC.
address_en: Civil Aviation Museum of China

Suzhou Bay Tourist Area is located on the shores of Taihu Lake in Wujiang District, Suzhou. Featuring expansive lake views and waterscapes, it integrates a water park, waterfront walkways, and leisure and vacation facilities, making it a leisure destination on Taihu Lake that combines sightseeing and recreation.

intro_en: The Red Brick Art Museum is located in the No. 1 Di International Art Zone in the northeastern part of Chaoyang District, Beijing. It was founded by the collector couple Yan Shijie and Cao Mei. In December 2012, the Red Brick Art Museum was initially completed and began trial operations, and it officially opened to the public in May 2014. The museum building and its garden were designed by Dong Yugan, a professor at the Architectural Research Center of Peking University. It is a garden-style museum of landscape courtyards, with red brick as its main building material. The grounds cover an area of approximately 20,000 square meters, while the exhibition halls cover nearly 10,000 square meters. Since its opening, the Red Brick Art Museum has hosted various large-scale exhibitions, such as the 2017 March collection exhibition "Chen Chieh-jen: On the Empire's Borders."

intro_en:
Location: Hangzhou Arts and Crafts Museum

The Hangzhou Arts and Crafts Museum Cluster is located at No. 334 Xiaohe Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China, in the historic and cultural district west of Gongchen Bridge. With Hangzhou's arts and crafts heritage as its theme, the cluster comprises four museums—Hangzhou Arts and Crafts Museum, China Knife, Scissors and Sword Museum, China Fan Museum, and China Umbrella Museum—operating as one institution under four names. The Knife, Scissors and Sword Museum, Fan Museum, and Umbrella Museum were completed in September 2009, and the Hangzhou Arts and Crafts Museum in September 2011. All the museum buildings were converted from industrial heritage sites, including the Hangzhou No. 1 Cotton Mill (Tongyi Cotton Mill), the Honglei Lace Weaving Factory, and the Qiaoxi Local Products Warehouse.

intro_en: Qibao Old Street is an ancient-architecture attraction located in Qibao Town, Minhang District, Shanghai, People's Republic of China. It is about 550 meters long from north to south and 200 meters wide from east to west. It was restored and reopened to the public in 2000. The residential buildings, shops, and bridges in the scenic area feature Ming and Qing dynasty architectural styles. The area contains a commercial street perpendicular to the Puhuitang River; the section north of the Puhuitang is North Street, and the section to the south is South Street. The area also features waterside pavilions, stilted buildings, arch bridges, the Zhang Chongren Memorial Hall, a cotton-weaving workshop, traditional trades exhibits, Qibao Old Wine Workshop, Qibao Old Pawnshop, Qibao Cricket Hall, the Zhou Family Miniature Museum, Qibao Temple, and more.

intro_en: Opened on September 21, 1991, the museum covers an area of 9,460 square meters, with its main building shaped like the "Silk Road." The museum presents the history of silk production and Suzhou embroidery dating back to 2000 BC. Exhibits include old looms, ancient silk samples, and an introduction to silkworm raising. There used to be a room filled with live silkworms eating mulberry leaves and spinning cocoons. However, after December 2009, the live silkworms were replaced by models. There are still some live silkworms on display (2018), about 10% of the number of models.

intro_en:
Location: Baidicheng · Qutang Gorge Scenic Area

Baidicheng, located on the north bank of the Yangtze River at the mouth of Qutang Gorge in Fengjie, Chongqing, is famous for Li Bai's verse "At dawn I leave Baidicheng amid colorful clouds." Qutang Gorge is one of the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River, with the majestic Kuimen Gate towering within it, renowned for its grandeur, steepness, and dramatic beauty.

intro: 明孝陵博物馆位于中国江苏省南京市玄武区中山门外四方城1号、明孝陵景区大金门入口东南侧，为展示明孝陵及其所代表的明文化的专题博物馆，馆址最初设于梅花山暗香阁，现馆址为利用原南京手表厂部分旧厂房改造而成，2009年2月对外开放 ，基本陈列为《大明孝陵》（分为孝陵雄姿、传奇帝王、选址建陵、创新规制、历史地位、孝陵沧桑等六个部分），并设有明式家具馆、织锦馆、茶艺馆和360度环幕影院等 。
intro_en: The Ming Xiaoling Museum is located at No. 1 Sifangcheng, outside Zhongshan Gate, Xuanwu District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China, on the southeast side of the Great Golden Gate entrance of the Ming Xiaoling Scenic Area. It is a thematic museum showcasing the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum and the Ming culture it represents. The museum was originally housed in the Anxiang Pavilion at Meihua Mountain (Plum Blossom Hill); its current site was converted from part of the former Nanjing Watch Factory buildings and opened to the public in February 2009. Its permanent exhibition, "The Great Ming Xiaoling," consists of six sections: the Grandeur of Xiaoling, the Legendary Emperor, Site Selection and Mausoleum Construction, Innovative Regulations, Historical Status, and the Vicissitudes of Xiaoling. The museum also features a Ming-style Furniture Hall, a Brocade Hall, a Tea Art Hall, and a 360-degree circular-screen theater.

address: 湖北省武汉市江汉区常青街道青年路辅路武汉博物馆
intro: 武汉博物馆是以展示武汉地区历史文化为主的地志类综合性博物馆，位于中華人民共和國湖北省武漢市江汉区常青街道青年路373号，建筑面积17834平方米，展示面积6000平方米，库房面积4000平方米。 2008年5月被评为首批国家一级博物馆。馆内基本陈列包括地方史陈列《武汉古代历史》、《武汉近现代历史》以及专题艺术陈列《历代文物珍藏》、《古代陶瓷艺术》和《明清书画艺术》。2005年被国家旅游局评定为中国国家4A级旅游景区。
intro_en: Wuhan Museum is a comprehensive regional museum focusing on the history and culture of the Wuhan area. It is located at No. 373 Qingnian Road, Changqing Subdistrict, Jianghan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China, with a building area of 17,834 square meters, an exhibition area of 6,000 square meters, and a storage area of 4,000 square meters. In May 2008, it was rated as one of the first batch of National First-Class Museums. Its permanent exhibitions include the local history displays "Ancient History of Wuhan" and "Modern and Contemporary History of Wuhan," as well as the thematic art displays "Treasured Cultural Relics Through the Ages," "Ancient Ceramic Art," and "Painting and Calligraphy Art of the Ming and Qing Dynasties." In 2005, it was rated as a National 4A-Level Tourist Attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

intro: 今日美术馆于2002年由地产商张宝全创建。此后5年靠张宝全每年投入上千万元维持。2006年7月，今日美术馆成为北京市首家在北京市民政局注册为民办非企业单位的民营美术馆。此后，该馆围绕普通参观者、会员参观者、捐赠者这三个层次，形成了一套寻找个人及企业资助的机制。2010年，该馆获得的赞助款已达3000万元人民币。
intro_en: Today Art Museum was founded in 2002 by real estate developer Zhang Baoquan. For the following five years, it was sustained by Zhang's annual investment of over 10 million yuan. In July 2006, Today Art Museum became the first private art museum in Beijing to be registered with the Beijing Municipal Civil Affairs Bureau as a private non-enterprise entity. Since then, the museum has developed a mechanism for seeking individual and corporate sponsorship around three tiers: general visitors, member visitors, and donors. By 2010, the sponsorship it had received had reached 30 million yuan.

intro: 上海世博会博物馆（ ）坐落于上海黄浦区蒙自路818号，是国际展览局唯一官方博物馆和官方文献中心，由上海市政府和国际展览局合作共建，具有国际性、唯一性、专题性、可持续性等特点。它既是国内第一座真正意义上的国际性博物馆，也是全世界独一无二的全面展示世博专题的博物馆，并将打造成为世界认可、中国一流、上海补缺、特色鲜明的国际化、开放性的设计创意类博物馆及国际学术交流中心。
intro_en:
Location: World Expo Museum

The Shanghai World Expo Museum ( ) is located at 818 Mengzi Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai. It is the only official museum and official documentation center of the Bureau International des Expositions (BIE), jointly established by the Shanghai Municipal Government and the BIE, and is characterized by its international nature, uniqueness, thematic focus, and sustainability. It is both the first truly international museum in China and the world's one-of-a-kind museum dedicated to a comprehensive display of World Expo themes. It will be developed into an international, open museum of design and creativity—recognized by the world, first-class in China, filling a gap in Shanghai, and distinctive in character—as well as an international academic exchange center.
address_en: No. 818 Mengzi Road (210m walk from Exit 2 of World Expo Museum Metro Station)
